विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः (1/53 व्यत्यस्त-स्वराः)

सर्वाष् टीकाः
Gemini 3.8 Flash

You are waters;
may I partake of your water.
You are greatness;
may I partake of your greatness.
You are vigor;
may I partake of your vigor.
You are increase of wealth;
may I partake of your increase of wealth.
Rich ones, take delight in this place of origin, in this cowpen.
This is your relative; do not go away from here.
Do not abandon me.
Become numerous for me.
You are united, having all forms.
Enter me with vigor, with lordliness of cattle, with offspring, with increase of wealth.
May your riches abide in me.
May I thrive with a thousandfold increase of you.

With ‘You are waters’—
for these are waters.
With ‘You are greatness’—
for these are greatness.
With ‘You are vigor’—
for these are vigor.
With ‘You are the increase of wealth’—
for these are the increase of wealth.
With ‘O wealthy ones, take pleasure’—
the cattle indeed are the wealthy ones;
the cattle are that which is between the two fires;
he has caused them to take pleasure in their own pen.
With ‘In this womb’—
for this is their womb.
With ‘In this pen’—
for this is their pen.

Jamison Brereton Notes

I render vs.-final kṛṇudhvam twice – once with vs.-initial ā́in the meaning ‘make = kindle’, rather than with most tr. ‘bring here’, and once with the quasiinfinitival dat. ávase.

It is not entirely clear why Agni is identified as Rudra here. The word is most likely to be construed with the gen. adhvarásya as “the Rudra of the/your ceremony,” on the basis of I.114.4 rudráṃ yajñasā́dham “Rudra bringing the sacrifice to success” and III.2.5 (also of Agni) rudráṃ yajñā́nāṃ sā́dhadiṣṭim “the Rudra of the sacrifices, bringing success to the offerings.” Perhaps the point of comparison is Rudra’s healing powers and, esp. here, his ability to ward off threats of all sorts, in this case the “unexpected thundering” (tanayitnór acíttāt) of pāda c.

ródasyoḥ can be either gen. (with most tr.) or loc. (so published translation). There is little riding on the choice.

As most interpr. take it, “unexpected thundering” is probably a reference to all sorts of unforeseen dangers, rather than specifically of a sudden storm.

शिव शंकर शर्मा - पदार्थः

पदार्थान्वयभाषाः - (अहम्) मैं उपासक (आर्क्षे) सामान्यतया मनुष्य के निमित्त (श्रुतर्वणि) श्रोतृजनों के निमित्त और (मदच्युति) मनुष्यजाति में आनन्द की वर्षा के लिये (हुवानः) ईश्वर से प्रार्थना कर रहा हूँ और मनुष्यमात्र के जो (स्तुकाविनाम्) ज्ञानविज्ञानसहित (चतुर्णाम्) नयन, कर्ण, घ्राण और रसना ये चारों ज्ञानेन्द्रिय हैं, उनके (शीर्षा) शिर (शर्धांसि+इव) परम बलिष्ठ होवें और (मृक्षा) शुद्ध और पवित्र होवें ॥१३॥

शिव शंकर शर्मा - भावार्थः

भावार्थभाषाः - अहम्=इस पद से केवल एक ऋषि का बोध नहीं, किन्तु जो कोई ईश्वर से प्रार्थना करे, उस सबके लिये अहम् पद आया है। इसका आशय यह है कि प्रत्येक ज्ञानी जन अपनी जाति के कल्याण के लिये ईश्वर से प्रार्थना करे, जिससे मनुष्यमात्र के ज्ञानेन्द्रिय ज्ञान की प्राप्ति के लिये चेष्टा करें ॥१३॥

शिव शंकर शर्मा - पदार्थः

पदार्थान्वयभाषाः - अहमुपासकः। आर्क्षे=सामान्येन सर्वेषां मनुष्याणां निमित्ते। श्रुतर्वणि=श्रोतॄणां निमित्ते। मदच्युति=आनन्दानां च्योतनाय। हुवानः=परमात्मानं स्तुवन्नस्मि। स्तुकाविनां= विज्ञानादिसहितानाम्। चतुर्णाम्=चक्षुरादीनाम्। शीर्षा=शिरांसि। शर्धांसि इव=बलवन्ति इव भवन्तु। तथा मृक्षा=शुद्धानि भवन्तु ॥१३॥
